description: Implementation of socket operations for QUIC protocol, including socket creation, configuration, acceptance, data transmission, and error handling, specific to POSIX systems.

methods.name: ToPlatformSocketType
methods.description: Converts internal SocketProtocol enum to platform-specific socket type constants.

methods.name: ToPlatformProtocol
methods.description: Converts internal SocketProtocol enum to platform-specific protocol constants.

methods.name: ToStatus
methods.description: Converts errno error numbers to absl::Status, mapping specific error numbers to Unavailable or NotFound.

methods.name: SetSocketFlags
methods.description: Sets socket file descriptor flags using fcntl, handling EINTR and errors.

methods.name: ValidateAndConvertAddress
methods.description: Validates sockaddr_storage address and converts it to QuicSocketAddress if valid.

methods.name: CreateSocketWithFlags
methods.description: Creates a socket with specified address family, protocol, and flags.

methods.name: AcceptInternal
methods.description: Accepts a new connection on a socket, returning the new socket and peer address.

methods.name: AcceptWithFlags
methods.description: Accepts a connection with specific flags (Linux-specific).

methods.name: GetAddrlen
methods.description: Returns sockaddr length based on IP family.

methods.name: SetSockOptInt
methods.description: Sets socket options for integer values.

methods.name: CreateSocket
methods.description: Creates a socket, optionally non-blocking.

methods.name: SetSocketBlocking
methods.description: Sets socket blocking or non-blocking mode.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for a socket.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for a socket.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects a socket to a peer address.

methods.name: GetSocketError
methods.description: Retrieves socket error status.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to a local address.

methods.name: GetSocketAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of a socket.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Marks a socket as listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, handling blocking and non-blocking modes.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives data from a socket into a buffer.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data over a socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a socket.
